Gifted: Explosion.name: Gifted: Explosion
Gifted: Explosion.description:
🧬 Explosion, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start each blast reaches a few meters, cracks concrete and throws an adult off their feet, and a blast aimed behind you hurls you clear of danger.
📈 With training: focused shots down a street, flashes that blind and deafen without injury, flight on chained blasts, wall-breaching rescues, barrages, a diving sky strike.
⚠️ It is loud and bright every time, so you cannot hide it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as every blast jolts your wrists and arms.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Katsuki Bakugo (Explosion).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Explosion.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Explosion family): Scale: the user detonates blasts from the palms (or soles, by player choice). A new adult user's blast reaches a few meters, cracks concrete and throws an adult off their feet; aimed behind or below, it hurls the user a few meters at a time. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: each blast hits everything in its cone, so crowds, hostages and fuel are real risks; bound or covered palms cannot fire; every blast is deafening and bright, so no stealth. At the start it cannot hover in place or make a quiet blast. Quirk Strain: light: a blast or hop; moderate: focused shot, flash, blast flight; heavy: breach, barrage; severe: signature dive, weaving through a whole scene. Type: Emitter. Law: an unlicensed public blast brings property and injury charges at once; police treat an unlicensed user as armed. Look: in use, palms glow and crackle; each blast throws an orange flash and gray smoke with a bang heard blocks away.
